acceptance: Rendered light and dark dialogs use the existing --overlay-scrim and --shadow-dialog tokens and fit the current visual style.
Desktop and 390px-wide captures show at least 1rem viewport gutters; tall content scrolls vertically and its close button remains visible.
Keyboard focus starts inside the dialog, Tab stays inside it, Escape dismisses it and restores trigger focus.
Existing dialog and invoice Save view tests, dialog Storybook tests and the frontend build pass; invoice saving/filter payload behavior is preserved.
tasks.description: Align the shared Dialog overlay and shadow with existing --overlay-scrim and --shadow-dialog tokens. Read DESIGN.md, PRODUCT.md and resources/css/tokens.css first. Preserve current viewport gutters, vertical scrolling, close-button visibility, Radix keyboard/focus behavior, and invoice SaveViewDialog payload behavior. Change only approved files; SaveViewDialog needs no change unless layout demands it. Update directly affected assertions and stories where useful. The existing unit, Storybook and browser checks already pass on the baseline except the intentional style-token check. Run sh /opt/pilot/setup-deps.sh from the repository directory, then PILOT_ASSERT_STYLE=1 sh /opt/pilot/check.sh. This pinned helper runs the scoped dialog and invoice tests, dialog Storybook tests, frontend build, and four real-browser theme/viewport cases including synthetic overflow. It records captures and checks; do not duplicate unrelated full-repository testing. Keep generated dependencies, build outputs and pilot-evidence uncommitted. Report actual outcomes, not assumed success. No backend or global-token edits.
